lines.text: Many learners say: My mother is kind. He cooks well.
Better: My mother is kind. She cooks well.
She! My sister is tall. She is a nurse.

data.wrong: My mother is kind. He cooks well.
data.right: My mother is kind. She cooks well.

quiz.stem: My sister is tall. ___ is a nurse.

native.tip: 한국어는 “엄마는 친절해요. 요리를 잘해요.”처럼 대명사 없이 말하는 일이 많아서 he와 she를 헷갈리기 쉬워요. 이렇게 말해요 👉 “My mother is kind. She cooks well.”

en.tip: Use she for a woman and he for a man. Say “My mother is kind. She cooks well.”
en.caption: Do you say it like this? 😅 “My mother is kind. He cooks well.” Use she for a woman and he for a man. Right: “My mother is kind. She cooks well.” Listen to Ama and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
